name: Bunty
label: BUNTY
look: a mischievous 10-year-old boy with spiky dark-brown hair, big brown eyes and a gap-toothed grin, a cream baseball cap worn backwards with a green brim, a green polo jersey with lime-green side stripes, dark-green shorts with lime stripes, white socks and green-and-white sneakers, often holding a cricket bat
personality: Cheeky, cricket-mad neighbourhood kid; always in the middle of trouble, terrible at keeping secrets.
catchphrase: Main ne kuch nahi kiya! ...Shayad thoda sa.
catchphrase_say: मैंने कुछ नहीं किया! ...शायद थोड़ा सा।

mouth.note: Gap-toothed grin. Needs a big, crisp patch (feather 2) so the closed grin is fully covered; smaller soft patches ghost.
